tldr: North Node in House 2: growth through money, self-worth, skills, possessions, and embodied stability.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop money, self-worth, skills, possessions, and embodied stability. The South Node in House 8 shows the familiar life field: shared resources, crisis, entanglement, debt, or other people's values. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to build personal resources that do not depend on intensity.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses money, self-worth, skills, possessions, and embodied stability in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 8 can pull the person back toward shared resources, crisis, entanglement, debt, or other people's values.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
